read_inputs: committed D6 R2 directory inventory JSON and summary
scope_and_non_scope.limitation: Findings cover only the enumerated manifests, candidate label texts, and the already reviewed R2 dataset-directory snapshot; they do not claim all local directories, root-external data, or unknown sources were exhausted.

ineligibility_reasons: all-only rows are assigned to val/test in manifest_all, not a robustness split
candidate sessions overlap current val and test
per-target-class and non-target counts are below 100

normalized_box_area_descriptive_summary.definition: normalized YOLO width multiplied by normalized YOLO height; these are descriptive bins, not an approved small-target cutoff

candidate_label_audit.label_content_hash_serialization: For each candidate label file, category + TAB + SHA256(raw bytes) + LF; lines sorted ordinally, hashed as UTF-8; paths and identifiers are not emitted.
candidate_label_audit.interpretation: Label text provides category placement, annotated box-row counts, and normalized geometry only; it cannot certify visual object count, complete annotation, no_hand/non-target semantics, occlusion, or image condition.

limitations: R2 binds path/size metadata, not image content identity.
Unlisted paths lack sufficient approved condition and person/session evidence.

metadata_capability_and_required_manual_.five_target_classes: Manifest label categories and YOLO text expose category IDs, box-row counts, and normalized box geometry.
metadata_capability_and_required_manual_.non_target: no_gesture is an empty-label category but is not evidence of no_hand; manifest_all-only rows remain assigned to val/test.
metadata_capability_and_required_manual_.multi_hand: Multiple annotation rows are a candidate filter only; they do not certify distinct visible hands or completeness. The 18 target candidate labels each contain one row.
metadata_capability_and_required_manual_.small_target: Normalized box geometry permits prefiltering; no accepted pixel/area cutoff is frozen.
metadata_capability_and_required_manual_.occlusion: No occlusion field appears in the scoped manifest or candidate label text; visual review under an explicit rubric is required.
metadata_capability_and_required_manual_.no_hand: Cannot be inferred from empty YOLO labels or no_gesture; five approved user photos are already assigned train/val.
metadata_capability_and_required_manual_.person_session: Current manifest has person_id/session_id and no observed cross-split overlap. manifest_all-only candidates overlap current test people and current val/test sessions. R2-only unlisted paths lack bound identity evidence.
metadata_capability_and_required_manual_.content_uniqueness: R2 path/size is not a content hash; independent identity needs content duplicate audit plus human condition review.

conclusion.reason: No scoped candidate pool meets both sample minimums and person/session isolation from approved train/val/test.
does_not_claim: exhaustive discovery of all local/external sources

algorithm: Strict UTF-8-sig CSV read; SHA256 raw source bytes.
Require approved manifest and reviewed R2 SHA baselines.
Exact set difference by image; candidate set equals manifest_all paths absent from approved manifest.
Aggregate by split and label parent category; emit no row paths or identity values.
Compare person_id/session_id sets and report only unique cardinalities/intersection counts.
Read only candidate label texts; strict UTF-8-sig decode, parse class ID and normalized x/y/width/height, hash category plus raw label-file SHA multiset.
Reuse already reviewed R2 snapshot by exact JSON/summary SHA; no image or annotation JSON read.
execution_and_counting_method.privacy_output_rule: Only aggregate counts, source names, schema field names and hashes are emitted; no raw person/session values or sample-specific path identifiers are stored.

command_exit_codes.purpose: recompute source eligibility and generate JSON/summary

validation_command_exit_codes.command: strict UTF-8 decode + json.loads + aggregate and summary assertions + raw-ID-pattern scan + source SHA reread
git -c core.autocrlf=false diff --no-index --check -- <empty system-temp file> <each untracked output>
validation_command_exit_codes.result: expected diff status; no whitespace diagnostics

validation.raw_sample_identifier_scan: PASS; no UUID-shaped token or known user-photo filename in report outputs
validation.input_sha_recheck: PASS; approved manifest, manifest_all and both reviewed R2 files matched report-bound SHA256
